tutorial.title: Snap blocks together
tutorial.body: Drag action blocks into trigger blocks to build a flow. Every panel you install can add its own blocks.

tutorial.title: No save button
tutorial.body: Everything you build is applied right away and saved as you go, so you can test it any time and come back later.

tutorial.title: Blocks out of the box
tutorial.body: Random numbers, timestamp comparisons and HTTP requests are ready to use before you install a single panel.

tutorial.title: Run from Home
tutorial.body: Pin a Run button to Home to start a flow without opening this panel, and keep an eye on its recent runs.
